# Melodic Subtlety – David Rivera

> Melodic Subtlety (2006) is a piano-led album by David Rivera, American composer. Free printable piano scores with chords are on Lackadaisical Perfection.

## Album
- [Melodic Subtlety](https://melodicsubtlety.com/): the album page, with tracks and listen links.

## Tracks
1. Halcyon
2. Clarity
3. Obsession
4. Whisper
5. Spada
6. Revelation
7. Sojourn
8. Constellation
9. Domani
10. Dream
11. Apogee
12. Atmosphere
13. Reine
